I made the repair on the number "five", which is `quantity.n.01 EQU 5` at gold position 3. The speaker first says "four".

**Concept numbering in the gold SBN:** 0 `musical_organization.n.01`, 1 `give.v.32`, 2 `time.n.08`, 3 `quantity.n.01`, 4 `concert.n.01`, 5 `city.n.01`, 6 `time.n.08`.

**Why the reparandum needs an anchor:** The reparandum `quantity.n.01 EQU 4` points only to a constant. The one edge coming into the quantity is `concert.n.01 Quantity -1`, and the concert comes after the repair. On its own, the reparandum would have no edge to another concept, which breaks R5. Because the quantity is a referent, I used device ⑤: I put an `entity.n.01` anchor just before `CORRECTION`. Both quantities now point back to it with `EQU`, and `concert.n.01 Quantity` points to the anchor too.

**Recounted indices in the new sequence:**

| Position | Concept | Index check |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `musical_organization` | — |
| 1 | `give.v.32` | `Agent -1` → 0, `Time +1` → 2, `Theme +5` → 6, `Location +6` → 7, `Time +7` → 8 |
| 2 | `time.n.08` | — |
| 3 | `entity.n.01` (anchor) | — |
| 4 | `quantity.n.01 EQU 4` (reparandum) | `EQU -1` → 3 |
| 5 | `quantity.n.01 EQU 5` (repair) | `EQU -2` → 3 |
| 6 | `concert.n.01` | `Quantity -3` → 3 |
| 7 | `city.n.01` | — |
| 8 | `time.n.08` | — |

The three forward hooks on `give.v.32` point over the `CORRECTION` box, which R4 allows. No separator comes after the repair, so no box connector needs updating.
